selection.description: A pull request receives the highest risk level matched by any changed path. Labels and author-provided declarations may request more review but cannot lower path-derived risk.

default.description: Unmapped behavior changes receive normal review and affected-test evidence.

rules.description: Documentation-only changes require format and link/build evidence.
Authentication and session boundaries require elevated review.
Database access and domain models require elevated review.
Client routing and shared state require elevated review.
Broker/API adapter changes require elevated review.
CI execution and governance boundaries require the highest review.
Container and release changes require the highest review.
Dependency, lock, environment-example, and disclosure inputs require the highest review.
